LanguageData.DMS_Mech_BullHound.label: bullhound
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_BullHound.description:
A heavy quadruped automatroid built for garrison duty. An enlarged derivative of the Dogge, it gives up the artificial-muscle agility of its smaller cousin for thick plating and a fixed back mount, and was posted at gates and corridor junctions of remnant installations to stop intruders at close range.
This pattern mounts an automatic shotgun. The mount is fixed and cannot be swapped.

A heavy quadruped automatroid built for garrison duty.
